sources.title: MEDA-YOLO: a lightweight multi-scale edge fusion framework for ...
sources.snippet: This study proposes MEDA-YOLO, a lightweight deep learning framework for pulmonary nodule detection using the public LUNA16 dataset. To enhance boundary-blurred nodule detection, a multi-scale edge fusion module integrates atrous convolution with edge-aware mechanisms for effective multi-scale edge feature extraction.

sources.title: GitHub - AJIGBOTOSHO/risk_nodule_stratification: Deep learning CAD ...
sources.snippet: About Deep learning CAD system for automated pulmonary nodule risk stratification (Low/Medium/High) from CT lung images, using a 2.5D DenseNet121 model trained on LUNA16, with Grad-CAM explainability. Built as part of a Biomedical Engineering final-year dissertation.
